resultText:
Writing up the result now — the spec, its checklist and the feature pointer are all written.

## Specification ready

- **`SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY`**: `specs/002-prevent-booking-overlap`
- **`SPEC_FILE`**: `specs/002-prevent-booking-overlap/spec.md`
- **Checklist**: `specs/002-prevent-booking-overlap/checklists/requirements.md` — all 16 items pass on the first iteration, with no `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers.
- **Feature pointer**: `.specify/feature.json` now points at the new directory.
- **Hooks**: `.specify/extensions.yml` does not exist, so no hooks ran and no branch was created; the work stays on `main`. Nothing is committed.

The spec has four user stories, in priority order: overlap rejected on create, overlap rejected on update, simultaneous creates, and the `/bookings` page message. It carries 25 functional requirements and 7 success criteria.

## Assumptions I made

Your description left these open; I took the simplest reading and recorded each in the spec's Assumptions section:

- **Order of checks**: overlap is checked last. An invalid key, invalid body, unknown room or unknown booking is answered exactly as today.
- **Races involving an update**: you named only two simultaneous creates. I extended the same guarantee to an update racing with a create or another update, since otherwise the rule could still be broken.
- **Rejected create and its key**: nothing is stored against the `Idempotency-Key`, so it can be reused with any body, the same as for failed validation today.
- **Replays**: a replay of a completed create returns the stored answer without an overlap check, because it creates nothing.
- **Message wording**: not prescribed; it only has to say the room is already booked for that time, and it does not name the conflicting booking.
- **"Next to the form"**: the message appears in or beside the form that was submitted, and the edit form stays open.
- **Page tests**: the page behaviour is covered by tests with the service layer mocked, as for the existing page.
- **Relation to spec 001**: this spec overrides its "no overlap rule" assumption and its contract freeze for the one new error code; the 001 files are not edited.

The checklist item "no implementation details" passes with one stated exception: routes, status codes, error codes, the header name and the three commands are quoted from your description.

The spec is ready for `/speckit-plan`; `/speckit-clarify` is only worth running if you disagree with one of the assumptions above.
